verdict.rationale: Better Stack ships a first-party AI SRE agent that users can chat with online, in Slack via @betterstack, or in MS Teams. Users can delegate incident investigation across logs, metrics, traces and errors, natural-language log and chart queries, automated post-mortems, AI-suggested Linear tickets, and GitHub pull requests with suggested fixes, with a choice of models and human approval before actions. missing for 10: in-depth docs on the in-dashboard chat experience (most evidence is Slack-centric marketing copy), independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent's task delegation.
